item.tib: zhi khro dgongs pa kun 'dus thos chog rang grol chen po'i ngo sprod rgyas pa
item.coloph: ces zhi khro bar do thos grol gyi ngo sprod chen mo 'di ni snyigs dus rnal 'byor ba kun grol grags pa'i dpal yon can gyis shar rdza 'bum smad dgon pa mi g.yo bsam gtan gling (du)/ rlung sems zung du 'jug pa'i nyams len gyi thun mtshams su brtsams pa/ me glang hor zla gsum pa'i dkar phyogs su grub pa'i drung yig pa ni nye gnas pa chos bzang rdo rjes byas pa lus can thar pa thob pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
